page.title: Workflows and SOPs
page.description: Publish the way your team works as an executable Workflow. Every run locks a version and uses Stages to coordinate Tasks, people, Agents, and shared context.
page.empty_description: A Space can still manage plain Tasks. Create a Workflow only when the work benefits from a repeatable process.

designer.library_description: Create and maintain reusable processes for this Project. Tasks and run boards remain in the Project Task page.
designer.empty_existing: Start with a template above or create a blank SOP.
designer.project_available_hint: Run a Space SOP directly or create a Project variant
designer.space_asset_hint: Reusable process assets for every Project in this Space
designer.run_dialog_description: Give this run of “{{name}}” a distinct name so the team can identify it later.
designer.project_runs_hint: See every SOP started in this Project, including its run name, source, current Stage, and status.
designer.no_project_runs: No SOP has been started in this Project yet.
designer.run_plan_description: Fine-tune this run of “{{name}}” without changing the published SOP.
designer.run_plan_scope_title: Changes apply only to this run
designer.run_plan_scope_hint: Completed Stages stay locked. Changes to the current Stage affect only Tasks and Agents started after you save.
designer.run_plan_stages_hint: Future Stages without Tasks or gate decisions can be reordered or removed.
designer.run_plan_current_hint: Updates here do not rewrite Tasks or Agent runs that already started.
designer.run_plan_note_hint: Explain why this run needs adjustment
designer.run_plan_confirm_description: Save {{count}} changes to this run? The published SOP stays unchanged, and current-Stage changes affect only new Tasks and Agent runs.
designer.editor_hint: Configure Stages, inputs, outputs, Skills, and exit gates.
designer.stage_list_hint: Stage order defines how Tasks advance through the process.
designer.stage_description_placeholder: Describe what this Stage must accomplish and why it exists

evaluation_hint.on_task_change: Task and artifact changes run a lightweight rule check, not an Agent on every update.
evaluation_hint.manual: The owner submits the whole Stage before completion rules are checked.
evaluation_hint.scheduled: Aggregate Stage work at a planned time for reports and continuous operations.

designer.completion_all_tasks: Current rule: all required Tasks are terminal and required outputs are submitted.
designer.input_markdown_hint: Use Markdown to describe the documents, data, context, and prerequisites required before this Stage begins.
designer.output_markdown_hint: Use Markdown to define the artifacts, format, and completion standard required to leave this Stage.
designer.skill_snapshot_hint: Selected Skill revisions are snapshotted when the SOP run starts.
designer.mcp_inherit_hint: This Stage may use every workspace MCP server granted to the executing agent.
designer.mcp_none_hint: Tasks in this Stage receive no workspace MCP servers.
designer.mcp_selected_hint: Only the selected servers are allowed, and they must also be granted to the executing agent.
designer.mcp_empty: No workspace MCP servers are configured.
designer.mcp_toggle_aria: Allow MCP server {{name}} in this Stage
designer.no_workspace_skills: This Space has no Skills yet. Create or import one in Settings first.
designer.gate_hint: The gate decides who authorizes moving to the next Stage after completion conditions are met.

decider_hint.human: A selected member of this Space reviews the Stage and decides whether it can proceed.
decider_hint.self_agent: The Agent executing the current Task checks its work against the Stage standard.
decider_hint.agent: A selected independent Agent in this Space reviews the Stage and makes the decision.

designer.select_human: Select a member from this Space
designer.select_agent: Select an Agent from this Space
designer.self_agent_hint: At runtime, the Agent actually executing the current Task performs the self-check; no fixed Agent is selected here.
designer.require_human: Require final human confirmation even after an Agent decision
designer.require_human_hint: The Agent provides its decision first; the selected member must confirm it before the Stage can advance.
designer.gate_actor_required: Select a valid member or Agent from the current Space.

designer.archive_dialog_description: “{{name}}” has no linked Tasks. It will leave run selectors, while its archive record remains here.

transcript.description: Agent runs, capability manifests, outcomes, errors, and full tool/file activity for this SOP Stage.
transcript.empty: No runs in this Stage yet.

execution_review.title: Stage delivery
execution_review.description: Review result version {{revision}} and its supporting artifacts.
execution_review.unavailable: This delivery is not ready for your review, or the evidence has changed.
execution_review.hybrid_sequence: Human review is available after the agent approves this result version and finishes its review call. Refresh the delivery to check readiness.
execution_review.waiting_reviewer: A decision is available when this delivery is ready for its designated human reviewer.
execution_review.confirm: I reviewed result version {{revision}}, its artifacts and required tasks.
execution_review.conflict: The decision was not confirmed. Close this dialog, reopen the delivery and review the current evidence before trying again.
execution_review.read_only: This delivery is available for viewing.

input_recovery.description: Update the Run inputs to resume this stage. Values already used by earlier stages cannot be changed here.
input_recovery.failed: Recovery was not confirmed. Close this dialog and reload the Run before trying again.

rework.invalidated_tasks_hint: Retained for history. These issues no longer count toward current stage completion.
rework.title: Rework stage
rework.description: Choose where to restart. Existing delivery from that stage onward will no longer count as accepted.
rework.confirm: I understand that affected work will stop and these stages will need new delivery and review.
rework.failed: Rework was not confirmed. Close this dialog, reload the Run and review the current state before trying again.
rework.unavailable: The Run is refreshing. Review its current state before submitting.
rework.history_effect: Previous work and review decisions remain in history and cannot satisfy the new delivery.

execution_config.manual_hint: People coordinate the work and advance the stage.
execution_config.agent_hint: Dispatch an agent and validate its delivery before advancing.
execution_config.executor_required: Choose an available agent before saving.
execution_config.review_independent: The execution agent and review policy are configured separately.
execution_config.rollback_hint: Choose an earlier manual or agent stage to restart from.
execution_config.run_inputs_hint: Provide the initial parameters used by your stage input bindings. Missing required values pause the stage for correction.
execution_config.completion: Advances after required work is complete, the delivery passes validation, and the configured review approves it.
execution_config.rework_limit_hint: Number of reworks this stage may initiate in one Run. Use 0 to disable rework; leave empty for no limit.
execution_config.rework_limit_invalid: Enter a whole number from 0 to 100, or leave empty.

contract_config.description: Define the data and files this stage receives and delivers.
contract_config.bindings_hint: Map an input field to Run inputs or an earlier accepted stage result. An empty path selects the complete source object.
contract_config.advanced: Advanced JSON · nested fields and constraints
contract_config.invalid: Check the contracts and input bindings. Each binding needs a declared input field and an available source.
contract_config.name: File name

agent_review_recovery.title: Agent review
agent_review_recovery.unavailable: Review status is unavailable. Refresh to check again.
agent_review_recovery.failed: The review call failed. The Run owner can recover it after resolving the cause.
agent_review_recovery.retry_scheduled: An automatic review retry is scheduled.
agent_review_recovery.missing_decision: The review call ended without a decision. The Run owner can recover the review.
agent_review_recovery.preparing: Waiting for the delivery and review preparation.
agent_review_recovery.description: Start a fresh review of delivery revision {{revision}}. The new call must record its own decision.
agent_review_recovery.budget: This recovery allows up to {{count}} review calls, including automatic technical retries. Calls may consume agent quota.
agent_review_recovery.confirm: I have resolved the cause and authorize another review of this delivery.
agent_review_recovery.changed: The review state changed or the result is uncertain. Close this dialog, refresh the status, and review it again.

retry_config.title: Technical retries and timeout
retry_config.hint: Applies to execution and reviewer calls. Attempts include the first call; 1 disables automatic retries. Timeout starts when a call runs. Empty fields use defaults; an empty timeout adds no time limit.
retry_config.backoff_hint: Set an initial delay to customize backoff. Use 0 for immediate retry. The multiplier defaults to 1 and the maximum delay to 3600 seconds.
retry_config.invalid: Use whole numbers within the displayed ranges. Set an initial delay before its multiplier or maximum; the maximum must be at least the initial delay.
